description: This file is a shell script used as a custom merge tool for Git, resolving merge conflicts in repositories. It provides various functions for handling different conflict scenarios, invoking merge tools, and managing temporary files during the merge process.

methods.name: is_symlink
methods.description: Checks if the given file mode indicates a symbolic link.

methods.name: is_submodule
methods.description: Checks if the given file mode indicates a Git submodule.

methods.name: local_present
methods.description: Checks if a local mode variable is set.

methods.name: remote_present
methods.description: Checks if a remote mode variable is set.

methods.name: base_present
methods.description: Checks if a base mode variable is set.

methods.name: mergetool_tmpdir_init
methods.description: Initializes the temporary directory used during merge.

methods.name: cleanup_temp_files
methods.description: Removes temporary files created during the merge process, with an option to save backups.

methods.name: describe_file
methods.description: Outputs a description of the given file based on its mode and branch.

methods.name: resolve_symlink_merge
methods.description: Handles the resolution of symbolic link conflicts during merge.

methods.name: resolve_deleted_merge
methods.description: Handles the resolution of deleted file conflicts during merge.

methods.name: stage_submodule
methods.description: Sets up a submodule in the index after a conflict.

methods.name: checkout_staged_file
methods.description: Checks out a specific staged version of a file to a working directory.

methods.name: hide_resolved
methods.description: Uses merge-file to hide resolved parts in conflict files.

methods.name: merge_file
methods.description: Main function to handle merging a conflicted file using various strategies.

methods.name: prompt_after_failed_merge
methods.description: Prompts the user whether to continue after a failed merge.

methods.name: print_noop_and_exit
methods.description: Prints a message indicating no files need merging and exits.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function executing the merge process by identifying conflicts and orchestrating resolution.
